name: com.jithox/eu-import-preflight

headers.description: OAuth 2.1 bearer. Discover the authorization server via /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource; PKCE S256 is mandatory; tokens are audience-bound to https://import.mcp.jithox.com/mcp with least-privilege per-tool scopes. A token issued for the Jithox E-Invoice server is rejected here (separate resource/audience). The workspace access key may also be sent directly per call (Authorization: Bearer <access key> or X-Jithox-Api-Key) when an OAuth browser callback is not possible.
headers.name: Authorization
